source.title: Regional Oceanography: an Introduction, retained online PDF compilation
source.edition_note: Retained compilation has per-chapter versions: chapter8 March2005, chapter11 December2001. Do not silently assign one publication/observation year to every chapter.
source.read_support: Figure8.6 and caption, printed111/PDF121; chapter11 Integrated flow, printed179/PDF189; Figure11.3 and caption, printed180/PDF190.
source.source_time_convention: Schematic surface circulation context, not an observed dated route or an annual range. Figure8.6 specifies April–November only for its western South Pacific flow; Figure11.3 contrasts late northeast and southwest monsoons, with flow south of20S unchanged in that schematic.

sensitivity_interpretation: Endpoint and drawing sensitivity only; not confidence limits, observed seasonal variability or annual extrema. All cases retained.
dateline_policy: Shortest geodesic legs; unwrap continuously only for display and test against periodic copies of coarse land. Never draw a line across the wrong side of the world.
